API Management publisher e-mail (required by APIM)
API Management SKU. Developer ≈ 30-45 min to provision; Consumption/BasicV2 are faster
GitHub repository that holds this solution
Branch, tag or commit to deploy
GitHub token with read access to the repository (only needed for private repositories)
Load demo orders across all regions after deployment (ignored for prod)

#!/bin/bash
# Runs inside the Azure deployment-script container (Azure CLI image), signed in as the deployer
# managed identity. Downloads the repository and runs ./deploy.sh azure.
set -euo pipefail

log() { printf '[oneclick %s] %s\n' "$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)" "$*"; }

: "${REPO_URL:?}" "${REPO_REF:?}" "${RG:?}" "${ENVIRONMENT:?}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- source code
owner_repo="${REPO_URL#https://github.com/}"
owner_repo="${owner_repo%.git}"
owner_repo="${owner_repo%/}"
work="$(mktemp -d)"
log "Downloading ${owner_repo}@${REPO_REF}"
curl_args=(-fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" -o "$work/src.tgz")
if [[ -n "${REPO_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  curl_args+=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${REPO_TOKEN}")
fi
if ! curl "${curl_args[@]}" "https://api.github.com/repos/${owner_repo}/tarball/${REPO_REF}"; then
  log "ERROR: could not download the repository. For a private repository supply gitHubToken (read access to contents)."
  exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "$work/src"
tar -xzf "$work/src.tgz" -C "$work/src" --strip-components=1
cd "$work/src"
chmod +x deploy.sh
log "Source ready ($(du -sh . | cut -f1))"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- wait for the Owner role assignment
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  rg_id="$(az group show -n "$RG" --query id -o tsv 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [[ -n "$rg_id" ]] && az role assignment list --scope "$rg_id" \
       --query "[?principalId=='${DEPLOYER_PRINCIPAL_ID}' && roleDefinitionName=='Owner'] | length(@)" -o tsv 2>/dev/null \
       | grep -q '^[1-9]'; then
    log "deployer role assignment visible"
    break
  fi
  log "waiting for the deployer role assignment to propagate ($i/30)"
  sleep 10
done
sleep 30  # authorization caches

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- python for smoke test / demo data
if [[ "${SKIP_SMOKE:-false}" != "true" || "${LOAD_DEMO_DATA:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
  if ! python3 -m venv "$work/venv-probe" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "python3 venv not available in this container - platform will deploy, smoke test and demo data are skipped"
    export SKIP_SMOKE=true LOAD_DEMO_DATA=false
  fi
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- deploy
export ASSUME_YES=true PYTHON="${PYTHON:-python3}"
log "Running ./deploy.sh azure (environment=${ENVIRONMENT}, rg=${RG}, apim=${APIM_SKU:-Developer})"
./deploy.sh azure

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- outputs for the template
outputs="$(az deployment group show -g "$RG" -n "tfso-${ENVIRONMENT}" --query properties.outputs -o json)"
console="$(echo "$outputs" | jq -r '.staticWebsiteUrl.value // ""')"
gateway="$(echo "$outputs" | jq -r '.apimGatewayUrl.value // ""')"
jq -n --arg c "$console" --arg g "${gateway%/}" --arg r "$RG" \
  '{consoleUrl: $c, apiGatewayUrl: $g, resourceGroup: $r}' >"$AZ_SCRIPTS_OUTPUT_PATH"
log "Done. Console: ${console}  API gateway: ${gateway}"
variables.d365Env: [if(empty(parameters('d365Url')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'D365_URL', 'value', parameters('d365Url')), createObject('name', 'D365_TENANT_ID', 'value', parameters('d365TenantId')), createObject('name', 'D365_CLIENT_ID', 'value', parameters('d365ClientId')), createObject('name', 'D365_CLIENT_SECRET', 'secureValue', parameters('d365ClientSecret'))))]

properties.environmentVariables: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'PREFIX', 'value', parameters('prefix')), createObject('name', 'ENVIRONMENT', 'value', parameters('environment')), createObject('name', 'LOCATION', 'value', parameters('location')), createObject('name', 'RG', 'value', resourceGroup().name), createObject('name', 'APIM_PUBLISHER_EMAIL', 'value', parameters('apimPublisherEmail')), createObject('name', 'APIM_SKU', 'value', parameters('apimSku')), createObject('name', 'REPO_URL', 'value', parameters('repositoryUrl')), createObject('name', 'REPO_REF', 'value', parameters('repositoryRef')), createObject('name', 'LOAD_DEMO_DATA', 'value', if(parameters('loadDemoData'), 'true', 'false')), createObject('name', 'SKIP_SMOKE', 'value', if(parameters('runSmokeTest'), 'false', 'true')), createObject('name', 'D365_COMPANY', 'value', parameters('d365Company')), createObject('name', 'DEPLOYER_PRINCIPAL_ID', 'value', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('id-{0}-{1}-deployer', parameters('prefix'), parameters('environment'))), '2023-01-31').principalId)), variables('tokenEnv'), variables('d365Env'))]
